downPayment.note: Down payment is calculated on the ORIGINAL gross quotation value, BEFORE subsidy deduction.

rounding.note: EMI rounded to nearest whole rupee. totalRepayment = roundedEMI × months. totalInterest = totalRepayment − principal.
